integrity: Mathematical proof and finite checker supplied. No independent external validation or priority certification asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact threshold is proved only for n>=4 and 2<=k<=n-2 with one consecutive terminal collapsed block. Distinct arrangements, all shortest words, and optimal-word uniqueness are not classified. Finite executable checks corroborate but do not prove the infinite theorem; earlier unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
title: Exact reset thresholds for cyclic automata with one consecutive block collapse
